questions.s:
Both aluminium and graphite are good conductors of electricity and have high melting points.

o: similarity: good conductors of electricity due to mobile electrons; difference: aluminium has a high melting point due to strong metallic bonds while graphite has a high melting point due to strong intermolecular forces

similarity: good conductors of electricity due to mobile electrons; difference: aluminium has a high melting point due to strong metallic bonds while graphite has a high melting point due to strong covalent bonds
